name: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited
summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited (JACL) makes and supplies performance polymers, chemicals and agricultural products in India and abroad. Founded in Gurugram in 2008, it has three units: polymers and chemicals, P&K fertilizers, and agri nutrients. Its consumer line includes woodworking adhesives and finishes under brands such as Jivanjor, Vamicol and Charmwood, plus maintenance products.
